# Solana OHLC API

> Build Solana OHLC charts with the Vybe Solana API for SPL and Token-2022 tokens: resolutions, wick filters, backtesting exports and on-chain charting tools.

This is a free demo that showcases the Vybe candle endpoints. Open it in the browser to test and demo them. Nothing to install. The linked docs pages are the Markdown versions.

## What this demo shows
This page charts open, high, low, and close from Solana trades for a token mint or one market. Set the resolution and a close-to-open gap filter. You can page the series and export the candles that loaded. The trade tape under the chart uses the same mint, and program addresses are labeled.

- Token candles: open, high, low, and close built from trades for the token mint.
- Market candles: the same OHLC for one market address instead of the whole mint.
- Resolution: pick a candle size, and drop close-to-open gaps for a tighter chart.
- Trade tape: trades for the mint load under the chart, with program labels.

## Endpoints this demo calls
- Token OHLCV API: `GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/candles`
- Market OHLCV API: `GET /v4/markets/{marketAddress}/candles`
- Historical Trades API: `GET /v4/trades`
- Token Details API: `GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}`
- Labeled Programs API: `GET /v4/programs/labeled-program-accounts`

The demo page is free to use. Token OHLCV is on the Free plan, the lowest tier. A free API key starts the first calls. Paid plans raise the rate limit.

## Demo
- [Solana OHLC API](https://solana-ohlc-api.vybenetwork.com/): Free browser demo of the candle endpoints. Chart a mint or a market, then export the candles.
